description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [Tactical Awoken Mode], [Tactical Awoken Mode: Serah (Ice)], [MAG +500 (25s) (Tactical)] to user.

description.name: Weapon Skill
description.text: One single piercing attack (31.00) capped at 199,999. Grants [Ice Damage Cap +20000 (Tactical)], [Ice Ability DEF and RES 30% Piercing (Tactical)], [Instant ATB 1], [Instant Cast 1] to user, grants [Ice Ability +50% Boost (Tactical)], [Ice 200% ATB 2 Follow-Up (Tactical)] to user if Level 2+ EnIce, grants [Attach Ice 2 with Stacking] to user if not.

description.name: Ice Damage Cap +20000 (Tactical)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap for Ice attacks by 20000, removed if the user hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Ice Ability DEF and RES 30% Piercing (Tactical)
Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Ice Ability +50% Boost (Tactical)
description.text: Ice abilities deal 50% more damage, removed if the character hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Ice 200% ATB 2 Follow-Up (Tactical)
description.text: Grants [200% ATB 2] after using a Ice ability, removed after triggering, removed if the user hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: 200% ATB 2
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x2.00

description.name: Attach Ice 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3

description.name: Tactical Awoken Mode
description.text: Keeps track of TP level (0~6), increases TP level by 1 when the character is hit by a damaging attack or an ally uses a damaging action, casts a certain ability when TP level reaches 6. Removed after 8 abilities.

description.name: Tactical Awoken Mode: Serah (Ice)
description.text: Ice abilities deal 30% more damage, have +10,000 damage cap, deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, trigger 2 additional times, have zero hone cost, penetrate 20% DEF and RES; removed if the character hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]
